clue.text: Rages on about stocking fillers

indicators.note: about here means moved around, so the letters of rages on are jumbled

explanation.surface: Someone rants about what goes into the Christmas stockings.
explanation.definitionFit: Oranges are a traditional small gift tucked into the toe of a Christmas stocking.

clue.text: This oven has a ring outside for roasting

indicators.note: the ring's letters sit outside, at the two ends of the word roasting, so they are stripped off

parts.note: the oven's name lies inside this word by coincidence of the deletion: stripping the outer letters of ring from it leaves the rest
ring taken as its own letters, split around the middle

explanation.surface: An oven described as having a ring on the outside for roasting food.
explanation.walkthrough: ROASTING is R + OAST + ING: 'ring outside' means the letters R and ING wrap the answer, so taking them away leaves the oven.
explanation.definitionFit: An oast is a kiln, an oven for drying hops.

clue.text: A child's toy surmounting the tree?

parts.note: a top is a spinning toy for children

explanation.surface: A toy placed on top of the Christmas tree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the tree?' completes the picture of the star or fairy perched on top; it gives no letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Atop means on top of, which is what surmounting describes.

clue.text: Gluttons for turkeys?

definitions.meaning: greedy eaters who wolf their food
turkeys make a gobbling call, so the question mark allows this whimsical name for them

explanation.surface: Greedy eaters looking forward to the Christmas turkey.
explanation.definitionFit: Gobbling means eating greedily, and it is also the noise a turkey makes.

clue.text: At the middle of Christmas a boy gets a cold meal

indicators.note: the central letter of the nine-letter word Christmas is picked out

parts.note: a lad is a boy

explanation.surface: In mid-Christmas a boy is given leftovers as a cold supper.
explanation.definitionFit: A salad is a dish of raw or cold food, a typical cold meal.

clue.text: Lots of entrances for Father Christmas

definitions.meaning: ... of something means a great amount
chimney ... are the way Santa comes into houses

explanation.surface: Plenty of chimneys for Santa to come down.
explanation.definitionFit: Stacks means a large quantity, and also chimney stacks, Santa's traditional way in.

clue.text: Lay on a party

definitions.meaning: to lay on is to beat or attack someone

explanation.surface: Organise a party for people.
explanation.definitionFit: To thrash is to beat, as lay on means; a thrash is also slang for a big party.

clue.text: Results are laughable when this missile is launched in panto

definitions.text: Results are laughable when this missile is launched in panto

parts.words: Results are laughable when this missile is launched in panto
parts.note: describes the creamy dessert thrown in slapstick comedy at a pantomime

explanation.surface: A slapstick projectile flung for laughs in a Christmas pantomime.
explanation.walkthrough: Pantomime is a British Christmas stage show for families, full of slapstick.
explanation.definitionFit: A pie full of custard, or foam, is the classic thing thrown in the face in slapstick comedy.

clue.text: It will make way for you in wintry weather

definitions.text: It will make way for you in wintry weather

parts.words: It will make way for you in wintry weather
parts.note: make way reads as step aside, but here it means clearing a road through snow

explanation.surface: Something courteously stepping aside for you in a winter storm.
explanation.definitionFit: This vehicle clears drifts from the road, literally making a way through snow.

clue.text: Winter dance thrown for enjoyment?

definitions.meaning: a dance held in snowy weather, taken as snow plus ball
something tossed in fun in a winter game

explanation.surface: A winter dance held just for fun.
explanation.definitionFit: A ball is a dance, so a snow-time one fits; it is also the packed snow thrown in play.

clue.text: Forces change in decoration

indicators.note: change tells us to alter the order of the letters of forces

explanation.surface: Armed forces alter the decor.
explanation.definitionFit: A fresco is a painting on wet plaster, a form of wall decoration.

clue.text: Craig's drunk and lit up after Christmas dinner, perhaps

definitions.text: lit up after Christmas dinner, perhaps

indicators.note: being drunk suggests the letters stagger out of order

parts.note: Craig's taken as the letters CRAIGS

explanation.surface: Craig, tipsy, lights up a smoke after his Christmas dinner.
explanation.definitionFit: Cigars are traditionally lit and smoked after a festive meal; 'perhaps' marks this as an example.

clue.text: Whence came the magic spirit of panto?

definitions.text: Whence came the magic spirit of panto?

parts.words: Whence came the magic spirit of panto?
parts.note: asks where the genie of a well-known Christmas pantomime story lived

explanation.surface: A question about where the pantomime genie came from.
explanation.walkthrough: Pantomime is a British Christmas stage show; one popular story features a genie released from an old lamp.
explanation.definitionFit: The genie in the Arabian Nights tale appears when the hero rubs this lamp.

clue.text: Stocking filler

parts.note: read not as a small gift but as the one who fills the stockings

explanation.definitionFit: Father Christmas is the figure who fills children's stockings on Christmas Eve.

clue.text: Rails when no crackers are put out

indicators.note: put out suggests the letters are disturbed and rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone complains when there are no Christmas crackers set out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'are put out' signals the anagram of NOCRACKERS. Rails here are birds, not bars or complaints.
explanation.definitionFit: The corncrake is a bird of the rail family, so corncrakes are rails.

clue.text: Wildly happy carol made up

indicators.note: wildly suggests the letters of happy carol are scattered and reformed

explanation.surface: A joyful Christmas carol made up on the spot.
explanation.definitionFit: Apocryphal means fictitious or of doubtful truth, i.e. invented.

clue.text: Songs performed by Sarah in the afternoon at the end of Christmas

indicators.note: in places the short name for Sarah inside the abbreviation for afternoon

parts.note: PM, post meridiem, means afternoon
Sal is a pet form of Sarah

indicators.note: the final letter of Christmas is taken

explanation.surface: Sarah sings songs on the afternoon of Christmas Day.
explanation.definitionFit: Psalms are sacred songs or hymns, as in the Book of Psalms.

clue.text: Party gatecrashed by posh couple

indicators.note: a gatecrasher gets inside the party, so the letter goes into the middle

parts.note: a do is an informal party
U is the abbreviation for upper-class, posh

explanation.surface: A posh pair gatecrashes a party.
explanation.definitionFit: A duo is a pair of people, a couple.

clue.text: Dining at resort, a customer may call for one

definitions.text: a customer may call for one

indicators.note: read as re-sort, the letters of dining at are sorted again

explanation.surface: While eating at a holiday resort, a diner orders a drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'resort' looks like a holiday place but is re-sort, the anagram signal for DININGAT. Gin and It is gin with Italian vermouth.
explanation.definitionFit: This classic cocktail is a drink a bar customer might order.

clue.text: Fruit put in crackers returned in container

indicators.note: returned means turned back, so the word for fruit is read backwards

parts.note: a nut is a fruit, the kind put in nutcrackers

explanation.surface: A fruit put inside crackers comes back in a container.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put in crackers' just describes the nut being cracked; it gives no letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A tun is a large cask, a container for wine or beer.

clue.text: A fool complaining about festive carousing

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the word for complaining goes round the fool

parts.note: wailing means complaining loudly
an ass is a fool

explanation.surface: A fool grumbles about drinking and making merry at Christmas.
explanation.definitionFit: Wassailing is drinking toasts and going round singing, a seasonal form of revelry.

clue.text: With respect, Ebenezer Scrooge initially has to pay up

indicators.note: the opening letters of Ebenezer and Scrooge are taken
in a down clue up means read from bottom to top, so reversed

parts.note: to meet a bill or cost is to pay it

explanation.surface: Ebenezer Scrooge, the Dickens miser, is respectfully asked to pay up.
explanation.definitionFit: Esteem means high regard, a synonym of respect.

clue.text: Hasty cards I'm writing out — in time for this?

indicators.note: writing out suggests the letters are set down afresh in a new order

parts.note: these words taken as their letters HASTYCARDSIM

explanation.surface: Someone scribbles cards in a rush, hoping to post them before the big day.
explanation.walkthrough: 'writing out' signals the anagram of HASTYCARDSIM. The definition is the date the hurried cards must arrive by.
explanation.definitionFit: The cards are written hastily to arrive by the festive day itself, the 25th of December.

clue.text: Light meal is something carried by Santa around the Pole

indicators.note: around means the bag goes round the pole's letter

parts.note: Santa carries a sack of presents
N stands for the North Pole

explanation.surface: Santa carries a snack in his sack on the way round the North Pole.
explanation.definitionFit: A snack is a small, light meal.

clue.text: Chief feature of a secular Christmas

indicators.note: feature of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: The main characteristic of a non-religious Christmas.
explanation.definitionFit: Arch as an adjective or prefix means chief or principal, as in archenemy.

clue.text: Article concerning author of words of "Away in a Manger"?

definitions.text: author of words of "Away in a Manger"?

parts.note: an is the indefinite article
on means about, concerning

explanation.surface: An article about who wrote the carol Away in a Manger.
explanation.definitionFit: Anon, short for anonymous, is how an unknown author is credited; the carol's lyricist is uncertain.

clue.text: Chain used as decoration, just over a foot

definitions.text: Chain used as decoration, just over a foot

parts.words: Chain used as decoration, just over a foot
parts.note: just over a foot sounds like a length, but it means worn just above the foot

explanation.surface: A decorative chain measuring a little more than twelve inches.
explanation.definitionFit: This jewellery is a chain worn round the leg just above the foot.

clue.text: Christmas fruit once revered in China

definitions.meaning: a small orange citrus fruit popular at Christmas
a high-ranking official of imperial China

explanation.surface: A festive fruit that was once honoured in China.
explanation.definitionFit: It is both a small citrus fruit and a senior official of the old Chinese empire.

clue.text: Sam has to look out for Ali Baba's opening word in panto

definitions.text: Ali Baba's opening word in panto

indicators.note: out means the word for look sits outside the name Sam

parts.note: to see is to look

explanation.surface: Sam must watch for Ali Baba's magic password in the pantomime.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Open sesame' is the password that opens the robbers' cave in Ali Baba, a British Christmas pantomime story.
explanation.definitionFit: Sesame is the first word of the magic command that opens the cave.

clue.text: A place to cook the turkey or thicken stew

definitions.text: A place to cook the turkey

indicators.note: stewing churns things up, so the letters of thicken are mixed

explanation.surface: Somewhere to roast the turkey, or to thicken a stew.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stew' looks like the food being thickened, but it signals the anagram of THICKEN.
explanation.definitionFit: The kitchen is the room where food is prepared and cooked.
